notes.title: Notification of the latest updates and fixes
notes.content:
Thank you for purchasing and playing 12 Hours Museum.
We have made the following additions and adjustments in the updates up to today.

The volume of various sound effects has been readjusted.
→The volume of footsteps and other sound effects have been fine-tuned.

Fixed the behavior when using cheat mode in English environment.
→Fixed a problem in which the commentary text is displayed in Japanese instead of English subtitles.

Added thumbnail materials that can be used for YouTube streaming.
→The material can be downloaded from the link in the official homepage.

The benchmarks that can check if this game can be run comfortably are now available.
→This is just a simple function. Please check the official HP for details. (You cannot play the main game.)

Added “Special Thanks” in the end credits.

We apologize that we have not been able to implement the functions of the game to our satisfaction because it is an indie game produced by an individual....
Please feel free to report any other problems or inconveniences in the comments or reviews.

Thank you for your continued support of “12 Hours Museum”.
Creator: Takahashi Yamada

notes.title: Notice of Update to Add Jump Scare and Other Features.
notes.content:
Thank you for purchasing and playing "12 Hours Museum".
We have added the following features in the update until today, July 13th.

Added a scare tactic to the entire game. (You can switch it on and off.
→Jumpscares are added at the title screen, at the beginning of the game, and in various anomalies.
The normal direction of some mutations has been enhanced.
→Objects and sound effects have been added.
Screen shaking on/off function has been added to prevent sickness.
→The shaking is originally quite moderate, but we changed it so that it can be turned off completely.
Camera sensitivity settings have been added.
→The amount of movement for changing the viewpoint with the mouse can now be adjusted.
Lap time measurement function has been added to some mini-games. (For time attack).
→The time taken for each lap is displayed.
The explanation of the game rules has been added to the Escape menu.
→This was implemented in response to comments such as "It takes time to understand the rules.
Added explanatory text in the gallery mode.
→There were some cases where people did not notice that they could "click to reminisce," so we have provided explanatory text.
Added "Special Thanks" in the end roll.

We apologize for not being able to implement the functions of the game to your satisfaction, as it is an indie game produced by an individual....
Please feel free to report any other problems or inconveniences in the comments or reviews.

Thank you for your continued support of "12 Hours Museum".

notes.title: Notice of Updates and Corrections through June 28
notes.content:
Thank you for purchasing and playing "9 to 9 Museum".
We have made the following changes and added the following features in the update until today, June 28th.

Added a function to turn off only the background music (the overall volume control function is already available).
Fixed a problem in which the end name is displayed under certain circumstances.
Fixed a problem in which the clear judgment of END2 does not stand and is not registered in the gallery unless the game is restarted under certain circumstances.
Added a hidden element (extra scenario) after unlocking all achievements (after completely clearing the game).
Added "Special Thanks" to the end credits.

We are very sorry that we have not been able to debug the game in time, as it is an indie game produced by an individual....
Please feel free to report any other problems or inconveniences in the comments.

Thank you for your continued support of "9to9 Museum".

notes.title: Notice regarding known issues (background music) and corresponding updates
notes.content:
Thank you for purchasing and playing "12 Hours Museum".

As of June 26, the following problems have been reported.

BGM is restricted during the streaming of gameplay videos on YouTube.
(We have received only one report at this time, but if you have confirmed a similar phenomenon, please comment here.)

All in-game background music has been uploaded to YouTube prior to the official release of the game, and has been tested with gameplay footage, and the production team has confirmed that there are no problems with distribution....

The following updates have been made to address this issue.
Added the ability to turn off only the background music in the settings.
The volume adjustment function for all audio, including sound effects, has been implemented for some time.

We are very sorry that we have not been able to debug the game in time, as it is an indie game produced by an individual.... Please feel free to report any other problems or inconveniences in the comments.

Thank you for your continued support of "12 Hours Museum".

notes.title: [For Beta Testers] Official Update at Release Timing
notes.content:
Thank you very much for playing 9to9 Museum.
We are pleased to announce that we have released and launched the official version of the game today, June 25, at 0:02 (Japan time). The changes and modifications from the pre-release beta version are as follows

The following changes and modifications have been made since the beta version was released
Beta testers' names are now listed in the end credits.
When using the gallery mode, you can now exit the recollection by pressing the "Escape" button.
When playing the end movie, you can now press and hold the Space key to play the movie at 10x speed.
Added a cheat to some mini-games.
Fixed a problem that prevented some effects from working.
Various effects have been enhanced.
Two changes have been made to the content of the anomalies. (Replaced with an extra mode).
Fixed a problem in which the game tended to overturn in the mini-game.
Added some effects, such as being able to touch the ball during some of the changes.
Fixed a problem with vertical synchronization (refresh rate).
Added several functions to the cheat mode.
Added skip function to intro. (Press and hold Space).
Added score attack mode to some mini-games.
The operability with the WASD keys has been greatly improved. (Fixed a rattling problem.) 
Fixed a problem where the light cannot be turned on/off when the camera is facing up/down.

Thank you for your continued support of "9to9 Museum".
